verses.text: Finally, then, brothers, we ask and urge you in Adonai Yeshua, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please ELOHIM, just as you are doing, that you do so more and more.
For you know what instructions we gave you through Adonai Yeshua.
For this is the will of ELOHIM, your sanctification: that you abstain from sexual immorality;
that each one of you know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
not in the passion of lust like the Gentiles who do not know ELOHIM;
that no one transgress and wrong his brother in this matter, because Adonai is an avenger in all these things, as we told you beforehand and solemnly warned you.
For ELOHIM has not called us for impurity, but in holiness.
Therefore whoever disregards this, disregards not man but ELOHIM, who gives his Ruach Kodesh to you.
Now concerning brotherly love you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by ELOHIM to love one another,
for that indeed is what you are doing to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to do this more and more,
and to aspire to live quietly, and to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands, as we instructed you,
so that you may walk properly before outsiders and be dependent on no one.
But we do not want you to be uninformed, brothers, about those who are asleep, that you may not grieve as others do who have no hope.
For since we believe that Yeshua died and rose again, even so, through Yeshua, ELOHIM will bring with him those who have fallen asleep.
For this we declare to you by a word from Adonai, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of Adonai, will not precede those who have fallen asleep.
For Adonai himself will descend from the skies with a cry of command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the sound of the trumpet of ELOHIM. And the dead in Mashiach will rise first.
Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet Adonai in the air, and so we will always be with Adonai.
Therefore encourage one another with these words.
